dedupe_keys.name: gridded population densities real estate prices transport and land use in 192 urban areas

description: This dataset provides, on a systematic grid, population densities, rents, real estate prices, land cover and transport times by public transport and by private car for 192 urban areas around the world. It is split into four themes (population density, real estate, land cover and transport), each as a CSV and an R data file, with a table of data sources and a land-cover reclassification sheet; the transport file alone is about 270 MB as CSV. It was produced by Quentin Lepetit, Vincent Viguié and Charlotte Liotta at CIRED (Ecole des Ponts ParisTech), with TU Berlin. Coverage is 192 cities worldwide, gridded within each urban area. Access: free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (published December 2021). Caveats: the source table must be read to know which data and year each city draws on, and transport times are modelled estimates. It supports accessibility analysis and land-use transport interaction modelling, calibration of urban economic models and comparisons of transport access across cities, and complements the global travel time to cities map and the Aperta accessibility tool catalogued here.
